items.t: Just wanted to add a +1 to “thank you for writing Leaf the way you do”. I see a lot of myself in her in a way that’s both uncomfortable and cathartic. That sort of thing sticks with you for a long time, and I really appreciate that her way of handling it IS messy and CAN be uncomfortable to watch. It’s uncomfortable to experience! And so much of how it affects you is just the little things in your everyday. Fears and reactions and impulses that more often than not, aren’t caught or addressed. In the end, that’s what you have to live with even when the “situation” is solved. Also her being fuzzy on her memories and putting more focus on the more “easily” digestible problems in her life… yeah. Or as I told my friends, “I feel some sort of way about Leaf.”
